programs.description: Ronnie and Bonnie are swindlers who consistently cheat innocent individuals and compel them for wealth. When the villainous Sashti plunders a shop and slays Bonnie's parent, he falsely implicates Ronnie.
The lives of Shankar, Sita and Anasuya converge in the Ramayana. Anasuya, renowned for her unwavering dedication, becomes a pivotal figure following Sita's abduction.
After a failing streak, a director chooses to take on a romantic film. However, the perfect book sets him on the path to finding the mysterious novelist to make a successful movie.
